title: Both in the Carrier
hook: Both cats are boxed. A person is in the crosswalk.
scene: Overcast midday on a two-lane downtown street. The Menace is in the right travel lane, moving. The carrier sits on the true floor right of the tunnel — not on the seat base — door latched, a readable strap around the box and the seat post. Gracie and Mya are both inside — orange cream chest, brown dark stripe — visible through the grate. Ahead through the mesh, a person in a dark coat is mid-crossing the marked crosswalk in this same lane, one shoe on the white paint, body in profile. The nose plow points at that person. A seated driver's right work boot: heel planted on the floor below the MIDDLE of three pedals; the sole faces DOWN and overlaps that middle pad with a readable hover gap — not flush, not in the gap between pads, not sole-toward-camera. The cats are cargo. The person in the paint is the decision.
debrief: Animals ride in a closed, strapped carrier on the floor. The person in the crosswalk is the decision you can see because the load stayed down.

source.teaching_target: Pets ride in a closed strapped carrier on the floor; a person already in the marked crosswalk stays visible ahead.

image_brief.camera_pose: Camera is inside the Menace cabin, over the wheel, looking forward through the windshield. Gauges bottom-left, coarse panel mesh across the glass, downtown street through the grid. Overcast midday daylight. Cabin matches the promoted Menace plate (flat painted dash, single nacelle, unbranded wheel, ball-knob floor shifter). Hold take-28 staging entire: cabin, closed strapped carrier on the true floor, marked crosswalk, pedestrian mid-crossing same lane. Brake-81 is POSTURE only — a seated driving foot, not a boot standing on the carpet: heel PLANTED on the floor below the MIDDLE of three pedals (clutch left, that middle pedal, accelerator right); sole FACING DOWN and overlapping that middle pad in frame; visible DAYLIGHT hover gap between downward sole and pad. Camera sees the TOP of the work boot (laces), never the sole. Do not say only brake. Do not copy brake-81's moulded dark Encore dash or black high-top. Y4 take 1 is Encore glass/cage/roofline only — not this cabin.
